demography_provenance.AMR: ASSUMPTION: admixture at 20 generations from {'CEU': 0.55, 'YRI': 0.15, 'CHB': 0.3}, Ne=18000. A three-way admixture standing in for the gnomAD "amr" grouping. Proportions are illustrative, not an ancestry estimate for any real population.
demography_provenance.SAS: ASSUMPTION: split from CEU at 1200 generations, Ne=25000. Placed on the Eurasian branch after the out-of-Africa bottleneck so that SAS sits between EUR and EAS in PCA space, which is the qualitative structure the equity analysis depends on.
